thread:
incident-bot: P1 ALERT: tenant observability gap detected for MarinerPay (dedicated-pool us-east-1). Missing traces and logs for tenant marinerpay-prod; p95 latency + errors rising. Incident page: https://redwood.inc/incident/3141592653 · paging on-call
eli: ack — i'm on it, grabbing context
maya: seeing trace ingestion drop to ~0 for that tenant in the bridge. forwarder error rate jump at 2026-03-15T03:10Z
cheng: quick grep of forwarder logs -> repeated 403s from S3 uploader: "AccessDenied: Request has expired". suspect credential rotation failed
ops-bot: Suggested mitigation: deploy ephemeral forwarder-proxy in customer VPC, route tenant traffic to proxy while creds fixed. runbook snippet attached
samir: prefer minimal blast radius — ephemeral proxy ok, but do NOT rotate IAM roles again without owner. need approvals
zoe: curl health on forwarder endpoint returns 502 and TLS handshake errors intermittently
maya: runbook command I'm about to apply (k8s):
```
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: ephemeral-forwarder-proxy-marinerpay
spec:
  replicas: 2
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: proxy
        image: redwood/forwarder-proxy:canary
        env:
        - name: TARGET_TENANT
          value: "marinerpay-prod"
```
eli: applying proxy manifest now, will create route & sticky session mapping to avoid sharding issues
cheng: confirmed creds rotation event at 03:10 UTC — token-provider failed to refresh because STS call timed out. pushing hotfix to token-refresh logic
maya: even after proxy up, traces missing from collector index for shard 12 — looks like metric partitioning dropped this tenant's keys during the error window
zoe: temp mitigation: enable trace-fanout for marinerpay-prod to global-collector (bypass shard routing). command:
```
curl -X POST https://api-redwood.internal/config/fanout \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"tenant":"marinerpay-prod","fanout":true}'
```
samir: note: fanout will send spans outside customer's dedicated shard -> data residency/reg compliance implication. we need customer ops sign-off for >15min
lina: @samir approved for 30m emergency fanout to restore visibility. customer informed and accepts temporary cross-shard forwarding
eli: proxy is live — forwarding metrics & spans. logs show ~3k spans/min accepted and 0 403s for now. partial traces reconstructed
cheng: rotation fix merged (PR: https://git.redwood/infra/rotate-fix/pull/87), deploying to token-provider; will kick reauth to forwarder 02:55Z
maya: kicking monitors: p95 latency and errors for marinerpay-prod. initial signal improving; error rate down 62% vs peak
eli: scheduling replay job to backfill missed spans once token provider healthy. replay command (internal):
```
redwood replay --tenant marinerpay-prod --since 2026-03-15T03:05Z --until 2026-03-15T03:25Z --target collector-global
```
zoe: I'll run the replay after the provider reports healthy and we've validated no more 403s. will monitor for duplicates
ops-bot: Mitigation deployed: ephemeral-proxy + fanout. Escalation: create postmortem + customer RCA. Tagging: INCIDENT-314159
eli: handing over operational follow-up to zoe (post-incident oncall). leaving a checklist in the incident doc
zoe: taking post-incident oncall. tasks: run replay, confirm backfill success, verify shard routing fix, draft customer summary. will update in 30m :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: NOTE: incident state -> mitigated; paging quiet. Please convert to postmortem and assign owners: infra=cheng, oncall=zoe, customer-comms=lina
eli: thanks team — nice coordination. moving to tracking ticket PERF-1243 for permanent fix and tighter rotation alerts
maya: retaining logs and trace snapshots for 90d for audit/backfill verification
zoe: final note: customer confirmed visibility restored in console; continuing 1:1 monitoring for next 2 hours
